---
title: Mixed and Comprehensive Practice
description: Integrate methods across multiple courses and turn evidence into a focused review plan.
page_type: unit
---

Mixed practice removes the topic label that usually gives away a method. Work
untimed first, document why each method applies, and use timed sets only after
your reasoning is reliable.
